# `profile.publish`

Validate/encrypt/deliver the latest local generation to the configured ENCRYPTED_GIT backend.

- **group:** `mutation`
- **posture:** `safe`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice profile-publish`
- **MCP tool:** `profile_publish` (mutation — hidden unless explicitly enabled)

## Examples

```
operator-voice profile-publish
```

_Synthesized from this operation's required arguments._

## Errors

| code | what it means |
|---|---|
| `invalid_arguments` | An argument was missing, had the wrong type, or wasn't one of the allowed choices — nothing changed. |
| `local_only_no_backend` | You are in local-only mode with no private-Git backend bound, so this is a safe no-op. |
